Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp varchar2(5);
 check_dup number;
 v_local_time DATE;
begin
 
 -- Converts GMT date to local date
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value = 'Y' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 --
 
 if :system.record_status != 'QUERY' then
 begin
 select territory_name,
 territory_id 
 into :territory_assignments.territory_desc,
 :territory_assignments.territory_id
 from valid_territories
 where territory_short_name = :territory_assignments.territory_short_name
 and exists (
 select b.territory_id
 from territory_assignments b 
 where valid_territories.territory_id = b.territory_id
 and b.recruiter_id != :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id );
-- and b.term_date is not null 

 :ctrl_block_1.t_name := :territory_assignments.territory_short_name;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select territory_name,
 territory_id 
 into :territory_assignments.territory_desc, 
 :territory_assignments.territory_id 
 from valid_territories 
 where territory_short_name = :territory_assignments.territory_short_name 
 and trunc(v_local_time) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+1) 
 and territory_id not in (select territory_id 
 from territory_assignments );
 :ctrl_block_1.t_name := :territory_assignments.territory_short_name;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11017');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;
 /*
 ** Do not allow any territory that has an open term date
 ** to be assigned to anybody
 */
 select count(*)
 into check_dup
 from territory_assignments 
 where territory_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and term_date is null 
 and recruiter_id != :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id;
 if check_dup > 0 then
 show_error('11053');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if; 
 /*
 ** Do not allow the same territory that is currently effective
 ** to be assigned to the recruiter
 */
 select count(*)
 into check_dup
 from territory_assignments 
 where territory_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and recruiter_id = :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id
 and ( trunc(v_local_time) between eff_date and nvl( term_date, v_local_time+10 )
 or trunc( v_local_time ) < eff_date );
 if check_dup > 0 then
 show_error('11053');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if; 
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then
 if :ctrl_block_1.short_name != :territory_assignments.territory_short_name then
 check_insert_rg('assign','C10', :ctrl_block_1.short_name||',','D',check_dup);
 end if;
 check_insert_rg('assign','C10',:territory_assignments.territory_short_name ||',','C',check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('11053');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('assign','C10',:territory_assignments.territory_short_name ||',','U',check_dup); 
 end if;

 :ctrl_block_1.t_name := :territory_assignments.territory_short_name;
 select nvl(sum(goal_count),0) 
 into :goals
 from goals
 where goal_custodian = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and substr(goal_mmyy,3) = to_char( v_local_time, 'YYYY' );
 end if ;
end;

declare
 nCount number;
 al_id alert ;
 al_button number ;
 v_local_time DATE;
begin
 nullchk;check_package_failure;

 -- Converts GMT date to local date
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value = 'Y' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 --
 
 if trunc(:territory_assignments.eff_date) < trunc(v_local_time) then
 al_id := Find_Alert('USER_ALERT'); 
 IF Id_Null(al_id) THEN
 Message('User_Warning alert does not exist'); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF ;
 set_alert_property(al_id,ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,'Effective Date cannot be prior to system date') ;
 al_button := Show_Alert(al_id); 
 IF al_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN /*-- User selected 'No' ---*/
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END If;
 /* show_error('11219');
 check_package_failure;*/
 end if;

 if :territory_assignments.eff_date between :territory_assignments.dum_old_eff_date
 and :territory_assignments.dum_old_term_date 
 then
 show_error('11156');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if; 

 select count(*)
 into nCount
 from territory_assignments
 where territory_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and :territory_assignments.eff_date between eff_date and term_date
 and recruiter_id != :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id;

 if nCount > 0 then
 show_error('11156');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if; 
 
 if :territory_assignments.term_date is not null then
 if not(check_from_to_date( :territory_assignments.eff_date,
 :territory_assignments.term_date )) then
 show_error('11013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 select count(*)
 into nCount
 from territory_assignments
 where territory_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and ( eff_date between :territory_assignments.eff_date 
 and :territory_assignments.term_date 
 or term_date between :territory_assignments.eff_date 
 and :territory_assignments.term_date );

 if nCount > 0 then
 show_error('11156');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if; 
 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 nCount number;
 v_local_time DATE; 
 t_eff_date date;
 t_term_date date;
 t_count number;
 t_eff_date_sec_recr date;
BEGIN
 
 -- Converts GMT date to local date
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value = 'Y' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 --
 
 if :territory_assignments.term_date is not null then
 if trunc(:territory_assignments.term_date) < trunc(v_local_time) then
 show_error('11219');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 /* As term date can be equal to eff date
 not(check_from_to_date( :territory_assignments.eff_date,
 :territory_assignments.term_date )) */
 if :territory_assignments.eff_date >
 :territory_assignments.term_date then
 show_error('11013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :territory_assignments.term_date between :territory_assignments.dum_old_eff_date
 and :territory_assignments.dum_old_term_date 
 then
 show_error('11157');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if; 

 begin
 select count(*)
 into nCount
 from territory_assignments
 where territory_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and :territory_assignments.term_date between eff_date and term_date
 and recruiter_id != :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 if nCount > 0 then
 show_error('11157');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/17/2013. SCR 19190
 begin
 select eff_date, term_date
 into t_eff_date, t_term_date
 from territory_assignments
 where territory_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and recruiter_id = :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_eff_date := null;
 t_term_date := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --message('Eff Date for this recruiter: ' || to_char(t_eff_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY')); pause;
 --message('Term Date for this recruiter: ' || to_char(t_term_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY')); pause;
 
 if t_eff_date is not null and t_term_date is not null then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_count
 from territory_assignments
 where territory_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and nvl(:territory_assignments.term_date, nvl(term_date, eff_date + 10) - 1) 
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, eff_date + 10)
 and recruiter_id != :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 --message('Count: ' || to_char(t_count)); pause;
 
 if t_count > 0 then
 show_error('11157');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 if :territory_assignments.eff_date is not null 
 and :territory_assignments.term_date is not null then
 select count(*)
 into nCount
 from territory_assignments
 where territory_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id
 and ( eff_date between :territory_assignments.eff_date 
 and :territory_assignments.term_date 
 or term_date between :territory_assignments.eff_date 
 and :territory_assignments.term_date )
 and recruiter_id != :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id;

 if nCount > 0 then
 show_error('11157');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if; 
 end if;
EXCEPTION
 when VALUE_ERROR then
 NULL;
END;

 default_value(:global.chapter_id,'global.chapter_id');
 
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.10';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.01';

PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: SANITY_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE sanity_check IS
 curr_rec varchar2(10);
 curr_item_id territory_assignments.territory_id%TYPE;
 curr_eff_date territory_assignments.eff_date%TYPE;
 curr_term_date territory_assignments.term_date%TYPE;
BEGIN
 go_block( 'territory_assignments' );
 first_record;
 loop -- Outer
 curr_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 curr_item_id := :territory_assignments.territory_id;
 curr_eff_date := :territory_assignments.eff_date;
 curr_term_date := :territory_assignments.term_date;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 loop -- Inner
-- message( :system.cursor_record ); pause;
 if :system.cursor_record != curr_rec then
 if curr_item_id = :territory_assignments.territory_id then
 if ( curr_term_date is null 
 and :territory_assignments.term_date is null ) then
 show_error( '11333' );
-- message( 'Msg: Only one term date null allowed' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
/*
 message( to_char( :territory_assignments.eff_date ) ); pause;
 message( to_char( :territory_assignments.term_date ) ); pause;
 message( to_char( curr_eff_date ) ); pause;
 message( to_char( curr_term_date ) ); pause;
*/
 if :territory_assignments.eff_date >= curr_eff_date
 and :territory_assignments.eff_date < curr_term_date then
 show_error( '11333' );
-- message( 'Msg: Date Range violation 1' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :territory_assignments.term_date > curr_eff_date
 and :territory_assignments.term_date < curr_term_date then
 show_error( '11333' );
-- message( 'Msg: Date Range violation 2' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if curr_eff_date >= :territory_assignments.eff_date
 and curr_eff_date < :territory_assignments.term_date then
 show_error( '11333' );
-- message( 'Msg: Date Range violation 3' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if curr_term_date > :territory_assignments.eff_date
 and curr_term_date < :territory_assignments.term_date then
 show_error( '11333' );
-- message( 'Msg: Date Range violation 4' ); pause;
-- raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop; -- Inner
 go_record( curr_rec );
 next_record;
 end loop; -- Outer
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_TERRITORY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select territory_short_name , 
 territory_id , 
 territory_name,
 null disp_eff_date,
 null disp_term_date,
 to_date(null) term_date_plus_one,
 to_date(null) eff_date,
 to_date(null) term_date
 from valid_territories 
 where :local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date-1, to_date(:local_date)+1) 
 and territory_id not in (select territory_id 
 from territory_assignments)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
union
select territory_short_name,
 a.territory_id territory_id,
 territory_name,
 to_char(b.eff_date, 'MM-DD-RR') disp_eff_date ,
 to_char(b.term_date, 'MM-DD-RR') disp_term_date, 
 b.term_date+1 term_date_plus_one,
 b.eff_date eff_date,
 b.term_date term_date
 from valid_territories a, territory_assignments b
 where a.territory_id = b.territory_id
 and b.recruiter_id != :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id
 and nvl(b.term_date, to_date(:local_date)-1) between to_date(:local_date)-365 AND nvl(b.term_date-1, to_date(:local_date)-1)
 and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_EMPL
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select substr(first_name,1,10) ||' '||substr(last_name,1,10) name, initials, staff_no from employees where emp_class = 'RECRT' and
 (lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+10)) AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id order by name

RecordGroup.Name: RG_REC
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select staff_no, InitCap(
substr(first_name,1,10) ||' '||substr(last_name,1,10)) name 
from employees 
where emp_class = 'RECRT' 
and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+10)
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
and ( staff_no = :ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id 
 or first_name like '%'||:ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id||'%'
 or last_name like '%'||:ctrl_block_1.recruiter_id||'%' 
 ) order by 1
